name: chest_front
prompt:
Generate ONE connected high-definition chest front material master, with the existing end pieces attached to the central panel. Reference 1 supplies the approved clean realistic grey-blue wood, smooth dark rusty iron, rounded rivets and subtle wear. Reference 2 is a strict assembly/layout diagram of the ORIGINAL three pieces ch1frle, ch1frntb, ch1frre, in left-to-right order. Keep their original coarse structure, plank COUNT and boundary positions, iron band shapes, corners, rivet count and any central hardware. Repaint fine materials at high definition; never copy or enlarge the native pixel texture.
The full connected rectangle is 3:2 inside a SQUARE canvas, exactly as reference 2. It fills the canvas width and leaves equal REAL transparent padding on the top/bottom. Its three eventual extraction regions are left cap 1/6 of width, square middle 4/6, right cap 1/6. Do not draw separators at those extraction cuts. Wood grain, plank joints, iron bands and material colour must flow across the internal cuts without a visible break, because these regions will be cut into separate texture files and reassembled in the game. The only ends or caps belong at the two OUTER ends of the connected rectangle. Keep all material inside completely opaque; background alpha=0. Real RGBA PNG, no fake magenta, black or checkerboard.
Fresh photographic/painted material scan, fine continuous natural wood fibres, gently curved cracks, subtle smooth rust stains; no pixel blocks, stair-step edges, dither, coarse flakes, scaly facets, gravel texture or chunky painted noise. Flat diffuse albedo, no perspective, added bevelled shadows, labels, frames around individual extraction regions or extra objects. Preserve the original medieval chest identity. One master only.
